cohorts.selection: Among first one-stone-next-opponent legal single-vs-double choice per deal/seat, retain only positions where a legal X-Y single and unopened X-X double are both available; choose smallest |X-Y| gap, lexical tie-break. At most one per deal.
cohorts.comparison: Both actions legal under provisional kernel; same position and pass-conditioned hidden worlds, same continuation policy. Double X-X vs ordinary X-Y sharing X, removed pip difference X-Y, X-X retained only by connector arm.
cohorts.limitations: NOT a causal estimate of branch unlocking or connector retention: pip gap, tile identity, opened number, and remaining hand differ. One-stone enriched sample; position-cluster exploratory CIs, correlated worlds, first eligible selection; pass-conditioned posterior ignores opponent earlier choice likelihood. Number locking and block winner/loneZero/bust/101-point match unvalidated. Finish-first is not match win.
cohorts.nextAction: Replicate in disjoint seed holdout, match or reweight exact pip gaps and retained connector count; seek authentic four-branch opening fixture.
